div.div:
صَعَقٌ is an inf. n. of صَعِقَ [q. v.]: (Msb, K:) and primarily signifies A swooning, or becoming insensible, in consequence of a vehement sound that one hears; and sometimes, such that one dies in consequence thereof: ―
-b2- afterwards often used as meaning Death. (TA.) ―
-b3- [Also] Vehemence of sound or voice: (O, K:) and vehemence of braying of an ass; used in this sense by Rubeh; (O, * TA;) and said by Az to be originally ↓ صَعْقٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
